record.paper_title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
record.context_brief: Existence for consumer-resource model with nonlocal resource perception
record.original_question: For the consumer-resource system ∂_t u = D1Δu − γ∇·(u∇v_g,R) + cβuv/(α+v) − du and ∂_t v = D2Δv + rv(1 − v/K) − βuv/(α+v), where consumers move according to nonlocal perception of the resource density v through a bounded-domain perception operator with radius R, in what sense do time-dependent solutions exist under periodic boundary conditions?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 14. In what sense do solutions exist solving the time-dependent problem (2.14) subject to periodic boundary conditions in a bounded domain?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded domain (for instance the flat torus $\mathbb{T}^n$ representing periodic boundary conditions), and fix constants $D_1, D_2, \gamma, c,  eta, d, r, K, \alpha, R > 0$. For a nonnegative function $v: \Omega 	o \mathbb{R}$, define the nonlocal perception of $v$ by
$$v_{g,R}(x) = \int_{B_R(0)} g(|y|)\, v(x+y)\, dy,$$
where $g$ is a fixed, bounded, nonnegative radial weight supported on the ball $B_R(0)$ of radius $R$ (with periodic extension of $v$ when $\Omega$ is the torus, or a suitable bounded-domain modification of the kernel when $\Omega$ has boundary, so that $v_{g,R}$ is well defined on $\Omega$).

Consider the consumer-resource system for $(u(t,x), v(t,x))$:
$$\partial_t u = D_1 \Delta u - \gamma\,\nabla\!\cdot\bigl(u\,\nabla v_{g,R}\bigr) + \frac{c\beta\, u v}{\alpha+v} - d u,$$
$$\partial_t v = D_2 \Delta v + r v\!\left(1-\frac{v}{K}\right) - \frac{\beta\, u v}{\alpha+v},$$
posed for $t>0$ and $x \in \Omega$, subject to periodic boundary conditions and to nonnegative initial data $u(0,\cdot)=u_0$, $v(0,\cdot)=v_0$ in suitable function spaces.

Determine an appropriate notion of solution (e.g., classical, strong, weak, or mild) and prove the global-in-time existence (and, if possible, uniqueness and nonnegativity) of solutions to this initial-value problem. Identify the regularity assumptions on the kernel $g$, on $R$, and on the initial data $(u_0,v_0)$ under which such solutions exist.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open question in a survey listing of open problems for knowledge-based animal movement PDE models with nonlocal perception. No published resolution establishing a complete existence theory for this specific nonlocal cross-diffusive consumer-resource system on a bounded periodic domain was located.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems concerning existence theory for consumer-resource PDEs with nonlocal perception operators.
status_evidence.claim: The existence question for the time-dependent nonlocal consumer-resource system under periodic boundary conditions is posed as an open problem.
